SPY.title: Nasdaq, S&P 500 Futures Slip As Traders Eye Presidential Debate, Oracle Rallies Over 8%: Economist Points This Shift In Broader Market Trend Amid Flurry Of Weak Data
SPY.description: Wall Street is cautious ahead of this week's key inflation reports, which will shape the Fed's policy decisions. Bargain hunting helped reverse sentiment on Monday, but the market remains volatile as traders await the economic data and the first presidential debate.
SPY.author: Benzinga Editor
